DashboardHeliusRings.title: Helius Rings
DashboardHeliusRings.subtitle: Shielded wallets and private transfers on Solana devnet.
DashboardHeliusRings.devnetBanner: Devnet only — Helius Rings runs exclusively on Solana devnet. Nothing here touches mainnet funds.

health.title: Runtime health
health.description: Live status of the Rings upstreams. Actions stay disabled while a component is red.

wallets.title: Private wallets
wallets.description: Each private wallet is bound to one SDP custody wallet and holds its own shielded identity.
wallets.empty: No private wallets yet. Create one from a custody wallet below.
wallets.name: Name
wallets.createFailed: The wallet could not be created. Check the details and try again.
wallets.noCustodyWallets: No custody wallets available. Create a wallet under Wallets first.

identity.reading: Reading the on-chain registry record for this wallet's owner.
identity.readFailed: The on-chain record could not be read. Retry shortly.
identity.explain_unregistered: The registry holds no record for this wallet's owner, so provisioning will create one. Nothing on chain is in the way.
identity.explain_ours: The published record is the identity this deployment derives, so provisioning already succeeded on chain and only this row is behind. Retry provisioning to record it.
identity.explain_foreign: The registry already publishes a different identity for this owner. Provisioning will refuse rather than re-key it, because re-keying would orphan every note encrypted to the published keys. SDP does not rotate an identity, so the fix is to bind this private wallet to a different custody wallet.

balances.title: Shielded balance
balances.description: Shielded notes held by {name}. Reading them is a full indexer scan, so it happens only when you ask for it — never on a timer.
balances.reading: Reading this wallet's shielded notes from the indexer.
balances.notProvisioned: This wallet has no shielded identity yet, so there is nothing to read. Provision it first.
balances.empty: No shielded notes in this wallet.
balances.degraded: Partial read — the indexer could not return every note, so treat this as incomplete rather than as the wallet's balance.
balances.readFailed: The shielded balance could not be read. Retry shortly.

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: Every shielded operation, newest first. Failed operations carry their failure code.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load Helius Rings data. Retry shortly.

composer.title: New operation
composer.description: Shield SOL or an allowlisted token into a provisioned private wallet. Confirm signs with the backing custody key and waits for the indexer.
composer.prepareFailed: The operation could not be prepared. Check the details and try again.
composer.anonymousWarning: I understand the counterparty is not disclosed on-chain. Anonymous transfers are subject to the same wallet policy and approval rules as any other transfer — they are not lower-risk.
composer.gatewayRedNotice: The Rings gateway is unavailable. You can still compose and confirm — the operation will run through policy and record an honest gateway failure.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Named destinations inside a wallet. Zone metadata is SDP-owned and works today; on-chain effects wait on the gateway.

recovery.title: Needs attention
recovery.description: Operations resting on a human decision. Approved operations execute against the verdict already stored server-side; a retry files a fresh operation linked to the original and re-runs policy, and retry chains are capped server-side.
